_note: Hosts that answer a human's browser but not this CI runner. A finding on one of these is classified `environment` -- reported with its evidence and counted in the digest, NEVER silenced and never removed from the crawl. Reachability is a fact about the environment, never a content finding (bin/probe_egress.py). Each entry records how and when it was verified from a real network, because an entry nobody re-checks rots into a lie: a host that genuinely dies would sit here forever wearing a reason that was true once. `verifiedAt` ages in the run summary so that rot is visible.
